analyst.summary: Radico Khaitan is riding India's premiumization wave in spirits extremely well — record quarterly profit, EBITDA margin up nearly 550 basis points, and raised full-year guidance for its premium portfolio. The business quality is genuinely excellent, but at roughly 91x earnings and after a large recent price run-up, the valuation already prices in a great deal of continued flawless execution. We rate it a Hold.
